Hey Helium D.,

I've seen you around on Instagram and had to reach out. I really love how you're helping people earn passive income through cryptocurrency.

However, your engagement is lower than it should be - we've seen similar accounts to yours crushing it on social media. Your audience of tech-savvy individuals interested in earning passive income are actively searching for reliable information and opportunities.

We specialize in growing Instagram accounts with real followers, no fake followers or bots. Our targeted approach will help you reach crypto enthusiasts ready to invest in Helium mining equipment and services. I believe that we could help you achieve your goal of expanding your community of passive income seekers.

I've prepared a partnership proposal for you to review here:
https://expandelevate.com/heliumdeploy.io https://expandelevate.com/?name=Helium Deploy&email=(email hidden)&username=heliumdeploy.io&sender=(email hidden)

If you have any questions contact our team via Live Chat on our website.

Best Regards,
Ashlyn D.
Partnerships Team

Don't want to hear from us? Opt-out https://expandelevate.com/unsubscribe
